title: Customer conversation follow-up
goal: Work the conversation inbox: find customers waiting on a reply or with no first touch, draft the next message, then schedule the follow-up with a task, tag, and optional workflow enrollment.

steps.description: Load open and unread conversations that may need a reply.
Find recent leads and contacts with no first-touch follow-up yet.
Pull the recent messages for a selected conversation before drafting a reply.
Stage an SMS or email reply with thread context for the user to approve.
Send the approved message to the customer.
Create the next dated follow-up task for the customer.

input.title: Follow up with customer
input.body: Continue the conversation and move toward the next step.

steps.description: Tag the customer with the current follow-up state for filtering.
Optionally enroll the customer in a follow-up or nurture workflow.

confirmationPoints: Before sending any SMS or email
Before sending to more than one customer
Before enrolling a customer in a workflow
output: Return conversations reviewed, replies drafted and sent, tasks created, tags applied, and any workflow enrollments staged.
